fee_notes: Application fee is $75,000 for new-to-system City Express by Marriott hotels (including conversions from non-Company Brand Hotels). Application fee is $100,000 for acquiring an existing City Express by Marriott hotel. An extension fee of $10,000 applies if a franchise agreement is not signed within 60 days after the first draft is issued. Additional pre-opening fees include: computer hardware/software systems ($52,500–$79,000), pre-opening training and services ($20,000–$30,000), Executive Orientation ($795 per attendee), optional FOND enrollment ($20,000), PIP fee ($12,000 for conversion/acquisition review), PIP revision fee ($5,000), PIP refresh fee ($6,000 at 12 months), and new PIP fee ($12,000 at 24 months). All fees are non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: You must pay an application fee of $75,000 for each new-to-system City Express by Marriott hotel, including the conversion of a non-Company Brand Hotel to a City Express by Marriott hotel. ... If you are acquiring an existing City Express by Marriott hotel, the application fee is $100,000 per hotel.
